title: ACORD 140 - Property Section
description: Canonical extraction target for ACORD form 140 (doc_type 'acord', acord_form '140'). A supplementary property section, normally filed alongside an ACORD 125, so it repeats the applicant identity and adds per-building detail.

buildings.description: One entry per building or location described on the property section.

location_number.description: The location number as printed on the form.

building_number.description: The building number within that location.

address.description: The street address of this building.

year_built.description: Year of construction, as a four-digit year.

construction_type.description: Construction class as stated, for example Frame, Joisted Masonry, or Fire Resistive.

square_footage.description: Total area in square feet, as a number.

building_limit.description: Limit of insurance on the building itself. Not the contents or business personal property limit.

contents_limit.description: Limit of insurance on contents or business personal property. Not the building limit.

deductible.description: The property deductible applying to this building.
